scope: Missing lifetime prerequisite for a proposed optimization; not a failure of the current Arc-based public API.

result.finding: After entering the actual engine epoch, unlinking the index and retiring the record destroys the PageValue owner when no Arc lease remains. Epoch-only borrowed record access is not currently safe. Existing public operations retain Arc leases.
result.next_requirement: Integrate record-owner retirement with the matching engine epoch before using borrowed pointers, including eviction, allocation failure, shutdown and stale-address tests.
